integrity: For any two distinct noncentral vertices u and v, the adjacent center edges cu and cv have local edge-resolving neighborhood exactly {u,v}. These constraints form the fractional vertex-cover system of a complete graph on the 2r noncentral vertices, forcing total noncentral weight at least r and uniquely forcing one-half on every noncentral vertex at equality. The remaining adjacent-edge neighborhoods are checked symbolically and are satisfied with center weight zero. A standalone linear-program verifier reconstructs all neighborhoods and the optimal face for r from two through eight.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to friendship graphs with at least two blades.
The one-blade triangle boundary is excluded.
Finite linear-program verification for 2 <= r <= 8 is corroborative only.
The introducing fractional-local paper was not available as full text through the checked open sources, leaving a residual coverage risk.
A differently named or non-indexed friendship-graph computation may exist.
title: Fractional local edge dimension of friendship graphs
